name: Film 02 - DhlA SN2 QM/MM reaction path
description: First step of haloalkane dehalogenase DhlA (PDB 2DHC): Asp124 OD2 attacks C1 of 1,2-dichloroethane and chloride leaves (SN2). QM/MM reaction path inside the enzyme: reactant and product minima, climbing-image NEB path (QST2-type), dimer TS with frequencies, IRC connecting reactant and product. MOPAC PM7 embedded in Amber14; QM region = dichloroethane + the whole Asp124 residue (20 atoms; Leonardo puts the full residue of every reacting atom in QM), charge -1.
